mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscle bundles to the skeleton was most worthwhile because the result showed how two pulling muscles move the same joint in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones to the elbow was straightforward and less involving, although the cartilage and fluid made the joint easier to picture.

surprise.text: I was interested that hard bone still contains living cells and blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: The muscle-cell and supporting-tissue pairing was a reasonable guess, but exactly how they formed bundles was not clear until the result showed the time strip.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the arm made the connection between its parts and movement understandable, and I would be curious to see another body system built that way.
